scalars.scalar_value: Two years acute care pediatric NP experience- required.
Mon-Sun, 7 am - 7 pm, 7 pm - 7 am (PHO); 5 am - 5 pm, 5 pm - 5 am (PICU/DOU)

items.item_text: CA NP, NPF, and RN license - Required
National Certification in Nurse Practitioner Specialty  as an Acute Care Pediatric Nurse Practitioner- Required
BLS and PALS certification from American Heart Association or American Red Cross  -  Required
Successful completion of a Master's Degree or higher in an accredited Nurse Practitioner program with a specialty in Pediatrics, Acute Care - Required
Two years acute care pediatric NP experience- required.

This per diem APP position will assist with our pediatric ICU, pediatric direct observation, and pediatric hem/onc teams.  The NP will need to be flexible and have the ability to rotate to multiple different pediatric specialty areas as needed.
NPI#, DEA#, Enrollment in PECOS, Enrollment on CURES- required
